## Abstract

What the prisoners see, and why it matters for education.

The prisoners see only shadows [@republic-slings, page 514 to 520]. Plato says so twice [@plato-republic, canonical 514a; canonical 517b].

> and they see only their own shadows [@republic-slings, page 514]

The fire behind them is not the sun.[^1]

[^1]: Compare the sun [@republic-slings, page 516].
